title: Agent & Execution Core
summary: This module defines the core components for agent creation, execution, and interaction within CrewAI. It includes agent adapters, execution engines, and utilities for tool management and structured output.

nodes.label: Manage Agent Extensions
nodes.title: AgentMeta
nodes.description: Applies extension logic like A2A during agent initialization, wrapping core setup methods to inject additional functionality.

nodes.label: Handle Agent Planning
nodes.title: handle_reasoning
nodes.description: Manages the agent's reasoning and planning process, generating a plan that is appended to the task description for execution.

nodes.label: Define Structured Output Interface
nodes.title: BaseConverterAdapter
nodes.description: Abstract base for converting agent outputs to structured formats (JSON, Pydantic), enhancing prompts, and post-processing results.

nodes.label: Integrate LangGraph Agents
nodes.title: LangGraphAgentAdapter
nodes.description: Adapts LangGraph's ReAct agents for CrewAI, handling memory, tool integration, and task execution within LangGraph workflows.

nodes.label: Integrate OpenAI Agents
nodes.title: OpenAIAgentAdapter
nodes.description: Adapts OpenAI Assistants API for CrewAI, managing tool configuration, structured output, and task execution for OpenAI-powered agents.

nodes.label: Execute Agent Tasks (Legacy)
nodes.title: CrewAgentExecutor
nodes.description: Manages the full lifecycle of agent task execution, including prompt formatting, LLM interaction, tool use (ReAct/native), and human feedback. *Deprecated.*

nodes.label: Manage Tool Usage & Caching
nodes.title: ToolsHandler
nodes.description: Handles the lifecycle of tool calls, including caching tool outputs and tracking the most recently used tool for agents.

nodes.label: Enable Async Execution
nodes.title: AsyncExecutorContext
nodes.description: Extends the base executor context to provide support for asynchronous invocation patterns, allowing agents to perform non-blocking operations and manage concurrent tasks efficiently.

nodes.label: Run Lightweight Agent
nodes.title: LiteAgent
nodes.description: A simplified agent for direct message processing and tool usage, supporting memory, guardrails, and A2A extensions without full delegation. *Deprecated.*

nodes.label: Control Tool Access
nodes.title: create_static_tool_filter
nodes.description: Creates functions to filter tool availability based on allow and block lists, enhancing security and control over agent capabilities in various execution environments.

nodes.label: Provide Agent Delegation Tools
nodes.title: BaseAgentTool
nodes.description: Base class for tools that enable agents to delegate tasks to other agents, including name sanitization and task execution logic for collaborative workflows.

nodes.label: Convert Tools to Structured Format
nodes.title: to_langchain
nodes.description: Converts various tool representations (BaseTool, CrewStructuredTool) into a standardized CrewStructuredTool format for consistent use across the framework, ensuring compatibility.

nodes.label: Auto-Generate Tool Argument Schema
nodes.title: _default_args_schema
nodes.description: Dynamically creates Pydantic argument schemas for tools by introspecting their `_run` or `_arun` method signatures, simplifying tool definition.

nodes.label: Create Tool from Function
nodes.title: _make_tool
nodes.description: Generates a Tool instance from a Python function, extracting its description from the docstring and argument schema from type annotations for easy tool creation.

nodes.label: Execute Tools Asynchronously
nodes.title: arun
nodes.description: Provides an asynchronous execution method for tools, managing usage limits and invoking the underlying async tool logic for non-blocking operations.

nodes.label: Validate & Resolve Tool Instances
nodes.title: _validate_tool
nodes.description: Ensures tool instances are valid and correctly configured, handling deserialization from dictionary formats to proper tool objects for runtime use.

nodes.label: Convert from Langchain Tool
nodes.title: from_langchain
nodes.description: Creates a CrewAI BaseTool instance from a Langchain-compatible tool, inferring argument schemas as needed for seamless integration and compatibility.

nodes.label: Simplify Tool Creation
nodes.title: decorator
nodes.description: A Python decorator that simplifies the process of turning a regular function into a CrewAI Tool, automatically handling schema generation and metadata.

nodes.label: LLM Integration
nodes.title: LLM Integration
nodes.description: Handles interactions with various Large Language Models.

nodes.label: Tasks and Flow Management
nodes.title: Tasks and Flow
nodes.description: Manages tasks, workflows, and their execution within a crew.

nodes.label: Agent-to-Agent Communication Logic
nodes.title: A2A Core Logic
nodes.description: Core logic for agent-to-agent communication and delegation.

nodes.label: MCP Server (External)
nodes.title: MCP Server
nodes.description: An external Model Context Protocol server for tool execution.

groups.label: Agent Core & Lifecycle
groups.title: Agent Core & Lifecycle
groups.description: Components responsible for the fundamental definition, initialization, and lifecycle management of agents, including extensions and planning.

groups.label: Agent Adapters
groups.title: Agent Adapters
groups.description: Modules that integrate different agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, OpenAI Assistants) into the CrewAI ecosystem, providing a unified interface for diverse LLM backends.

groups.label: Execution Orchestration
groups.title: Execution Orchestration
groups.description: Components that manage the overall flow and execution of agent tasks, handling LLM interactions, iteration loops, and asynchronous operations.

groups.label: Tool Definition & Management
groups.title: Tool Definition & Management
groups.description: Utilities and base classes for defining, managing, converting, and executing tools used by agents, including schema generation, caching, and access control.
